title: The Ballad of Zonge
lyrics: There once was a man who had quite a plan
To build a system that would set quite a trend.
Time after time, he’d hear the geologists whine,
“The rocks should be electrical, there’s a fault in the design!”
So Sumner’s student went afoot
With a digital dream and a computer to boot
He loaded the Red Baron, a Chevy packed to the brim
With instrumentation, wires, and a theory to spin
It’s too Complex, the critics would say
The Resistivity would be enough to dissuade.
But the sulfides were there, waiting to be found
All he had to do was image beneath the ground.
Backpacking a box full of bits into the bush,
What he discovered caused quite a rush.
He acquired IP but in frequency domain,
Using bandpass filtering and stacking through gains
But a problem existed of coupling response,
And he turned to Jeff Wynn to lead the renaissance.
With Wiatrowski and Bob Staley’s wits guaranteed,
And with Mr Young and Van Reed, they acquired with speed
There was Aiken and Rabb, and good ol Bobby Jack
They impressed that mining company, AMAX
For the data were fitted and the results anticipated,
And what they revealed was hardly understated.
They indicated that minerals not only existed
But it was possible that they could be discriminated!
Our Ken went from Zero to hero just like that
And now we carry on the legacy and tip our hats
To the man who chased signals beneath the land,
Building from the dust up, a long lasting brand.
Zonge International – imaginary and rational
We can help you find minerals and geothermal,
Or resources in general
We aren’t afraid of chasing breakthroughs
With surprisingly stable and able field crews
We provide data that is more than voodoo.
Our name is time tested and frequently resisted,
And our products so trusted…
It hertz.
